Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…

for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes…
Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

translations.web: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
translations.bsb: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
translations.kjv: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
translations.asv: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
